run_display_model: run DisplayModel to display model metrics and accuracy for a fixed response model
run_convert_data_to_parlai_format: run ConvertDataToParlaiFormat to convert a task dataset into ParlAI text format
run_verify_data: run VerifyData to check a task dataset for missing labels and empty messages
run_vacuum: run Vacuum to shrink a trained model file and optionally create a backup
run_detect_offensive: run DetectOffensive to scan a task dataset for offensive language using string or classifier matching
